content:
The iPhone 18 Pro will be unveiled on September 9, and according to the latest report, pre-orders for the handset will begin slightly later than usual.

iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders are expected to open on September 12 (Saturday)

Apple this week announced that its major iPhone launch event will be held on September 9 (Wednesday).

Typically, the company follows a very fixed schedule for its fall iPhone launch. After the event ends, pre-orders generally open on the Friday of the same week, with shipping starting the following Friday.

However, this year a slightly different arrangement is expected, and the latest report confirms this change.

This year, the "normal" pre-order day would fall on September 11 (Friday). The last time a typical iPhone pre-order day landed on September 11, Apple delayed pre-orders by one day to September 12 (Saturday).

Apple may be more inclined than ever to make the same arrangement this year, as 2026 marks the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks.

Macwelt, the German affiliate of Macworld, says it has heard from trustworthy sources that iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders will indeed open on September 12 (Saturday). The report adds:

The publication earlier this year incorrectly reported the launch date of the iPhone 17e. Therefore, while September 12 does indeed seem possible, the specific start time details may still vary.

In any case, there are less than two weeks to go before Apple officially announces and fully unveils the iPhone 18 Pro. For an overview of the rumored new features, please refer to our related coverage.
